verdict.rationale: A state business and lien registry could plausibly publish a programmatic API, so this axis applies. The evidence describes only a browser portal behind a credential login, with search, filing and ordering done in the UI, and probes show bot-wall CAPTCHA interstitials. The 'Data and Image Subscriptions' offering is a bulk-data product, not documented API parity, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
